## Security And Release Hygiene

- [ ] No private `.env` files, logs, traces, screenshots, runtime outputs, or local database volumes were added.

- [ ] Public examples use placeholders or `localhost` defaults.
- [ ] Dataset changes include provenance, manifest metadata, and required images/chunks.
- [ ] Dependency changes have been reviewed for audit/license impact.
